summary: Vendor-reported sign-in crash investigated. Recording showed the unified /login Escrow Institution tab. Root cause: SignInE used only the legacy escrow-signatory endpoint, so verified account-first escrow credentials were rejected. Fixed unified login to try escrow account auth first, preserve unverified 403 messaging, and fall back to signatory auth only on 401/404.
root_cause: Frontend endpoint mismatch: /login Escrow Institution role did not know about the v52d escrow_accounts auth collection/endpoint.

verification.recording_review: Escrow Institution tab selected; login stayed on the sign-in page with no visible application error details.
verification.pre_fix_repro: Unified /login with escrowdemo account remained on /login and showed legacy signatory mismatch toast.
verification.post_fix_unified_escrow: PASS — /login -> /escrow/me using the verified escrow demo account; screenshot /app/test_reports/iteration_70_unified_escrow_fixed.png.
verification.unified_supplier_smoke: PASS — /login Supplier role -> /vendor using the known vendor test account.
verification.backend_endpoint_smoke: PASS — vendor and escrow account login endpoints each returned HTTP 200 with known test credentials.

limitations: The exact reported production password was not available and was not requested.
Preview data does not contain an auth account for the reported email; production verification is still required after deploying this frontend fix.
action_items: Build and deploy a frontend bundle containing SignInE.jsx before asking the user to validate production.
After deployment, validate the real reported account on pmcmanagers.com.
